subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and
stimulus: column 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required.15 = 5 Column A Column B (a) Punctuality is a virtue (i) to become accurate in timing. (b) It helps (ii) gets late in his work. (c) A punctual person (iii) is loved by all. (d) He who is punctual (iv) we will surely succeed in life. (e) If we become punctual (v) which can make us successful in future. (vi) on time. (vii) respected and admired.
